method: scripts/native-sim/capture-color-space.sh opens bloxwaphig://gallery?colorSpace=<display-p3|srgb>[&component=…] in the same P3-host build. The gallery header shows the provider's resolved table plus a warning, negative and info Alert and a warning-tone Switch (fixtures/native/App.tsx ColorSpaceCheck). scripts/native-sim/sample-accents.py lists the most frequent saturated pixel colours.
screenshotColorSpace: simctl writes PNGs tagged sRGB IEC61966-2.1 (sips), so pixels are the sRGB rendering of what the P3 host painted; colours wider than sRGB are clipped

colorSpace=display-p3.warning: Alert border and Switch track render sRGB #f5b300, exactly the nativeSrgb token
colorSpace=display-p3.negative: Alert border renders sRGB #ff5c5c, exactly the nativeSrgb token
colorSpace=display-p3.actionAndInfo: Button fill and BrandMark render #00ff00; info renders #00bbff. The authored action/info colours are wider than sRGB, so an sRGB screenshot clips them and cannot confirm them; physical display comparison is #55

colorSpace=srgb (the #93 bug: sRGB hex r.warning: renders #ffaf00/#ffb000, more saturated than the token
colorSpace=srgb (the #93 bug: sRGB hex r.negative: renders #ff4a54/#ff4b54/#ff4b55, more saturated than the token
